mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% does not correlate with tighter monetary policy.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in a month signals weakening labor market conditions, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or UNRATE rise does not correlate with weakening labor market conditions.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) over two consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or RSAFS decline does not correlate with weakening consumer demand.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) by more than 1% in a month signals strengthening supply-side conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or INDPRO rise does not correlate with strengthening supply-side conditions.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an easing monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances despite the positive signal, or FEDFUNDS decrease does not correlate with easing monetary policy.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in Housing Starts (HOUST) and Real Final Sales (RSAFS) signals strengthening demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both increase in 1 month
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or joint increase in HOUST and RSAFS does not correlate with strengthening demand.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or UNRATE decrease below 4% does not correlate with tightening labor market.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) by more than 2% in a quarter signals weakening supply-side conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, especially during a late-cycle expansion.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or INDPRO decline does not correlate with weakening supply-side conditions during late-cycle expansion.
